svg.text: GHOSTED: ATS-9000, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Hand-drawn Bezier profiles extruded to boxes; palette rows only.
REFERENCES (local only, no web)
Mock ATS Tower (02-hub.png): cold blue, boxy
ATS Catch (05-ats-catch.png): keywords vs red flags
Kit (hero, 0.98 m)
Ricky v1
Ghostie v7
Ricky v1 lineup at the game camera (x2)
THUMBNAILS (10). Top: front, rough. Below: the same at the game camera (x3, 26 m, pitch 42, yaw 20, 90 px target).
1 screen head, top hopper, treads
2 BMGD: slit, back hopper (hidden)
3 Viet: screen, treads, stamp, no hopper
4 funnel head (head = hopper)
5 mailbox: front slot hopper
6 big CRT head, top hopper
7 side hopper on the shoulder
8 one roller, top hopper
9 stub feet, top hopper
10 box body, slit visor, top hopper
DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front, 3/4, back; then the game camera (x3), ATS left, Kit right (real v7 render, same camera)
A. INBOX BOT (pick)
Screen face + a funnel on the head top.
At pitch 42 the funnel shows a dark oval:
the 'mouth' that eats CVs, with no human
mouth. Treads + flared body = a stable toy;
the stamp arm breaks the box silhouette.
B. MAILBOX BOT
Tall body with a front CV slot under a
small screen. The slot sits where a mouth
would be: at 90 px it reads as a grin.
From above the slot is foreshortened
and the head is too small to carry eyes.
C. FUNNEL HEAD
The head IS the hopper: one bold shape.
But a wide open top over a face reads as
a bin: 'your CV goes in the trash' is a
mean joke, and the tone must be kind.
The screen also shrinks inside the taper.

Pick A. Reason: it is the only direction where all three 'reads your CV' parts show at the game camera at once: the screen face (front), the hopper mouth (top, seen from pitch 42) and the stamp arm (side).
It keeps the toy family (soft corners, big head, ink outline, dark base like Kit's trousers) and has no human mouth, so it stays literal and kind, not a grinning boss.
